init_nn_module: init a PyTorch neural network module with custom weight and bias initializers and an optional gain parameter
clone_nn_module: create N deep copies of a PyTorch module and return them as an nn.ModuleList
convert_numpy_to_tensor: convert a numpy array to a PyTorch tensor or return the input unchanged if it is already a tensor
review_init_function: review the init function that applies weight and bias initialization to a PyTorch module with configurable gain
review_check_function: review the check function that safely converts numpy arrays to PyTorch tensors while passing through existing tensors
